device: CPU only; no GPU inference or training
scope_and_cautions: Training means are means across logged optimizer updates, not validation/generalization metrics.
fixed scene ON excludes scene_variant=scene_off and rotating cases. Missing scene_variant in official fixed monitor cases is the default scene ON.
Fixed validation contains one fixed window per dataset and regime, not full RICH or full dataset validation.
foot_speed_during_GT_stance_m_s is 3D predicted foot speed on monitor GT-stance mask; it is not horizontal foot speed from the later support rechecker.
body_weighted is base.total minus weighted gait, so it includes every other base objective without claiming a coefficient decomposition of those raw terms.
Nonfinite metric values are excluded from means with explicit finite_counts/nonfinite_counts; audit lists raw nonfinite paths and steps.
The final10000-step nominal bin is observed only through55000: start50001/end55000/count5000, nominal_end_step60000, partial_nominal_bin true.

aggregation_definitions.training_bin: step s belongs to [(s-1)//bin_size*bin_size+1, ((s-1)//bin_size+1)*bin_size]; arithmetic mean of finite logged scalar values; no smoothing or per-dataset reweighting
aggregation_definitions.stance_raw: base.gait_stance_velocity (logged scalar; not multiplied by coefficient)
aggregation_definitions.base_raw.<key>: as logged base scalar, may already be a subtotal; do not sum all raw fields
aggregation_definitions.validation_dataset_regime_means: arithmetic mean of fixed sceneON cases across exactly3datasets, then arithmetic mean clean/noisy when combined; metric count retained per case; no stance-count weighting

best_checkpoint.selection_metric: arithmetic mean of clean/noisy raw world MPJPE, one fixed RICH VAL window, scene ON, head-only ego
best_checkpoint.selection_scope: Best among exactly matched checkpoints captured by this guardian; not full-RICH or historical global best
best_checkpoint.storage_policy: One best.pt plus original resumable last.pt; best is model-only

trace_audit.scene_on_adam_interpretation: If a parameter receives gradients only on trace.scene=true updates, its Adam step49468 after55000 global updates is consistent with scene ON count49468; this is a count consistency check, not an inspection of every optimizer parameter.
